name: Spot UV varnish
sub: A clear gloss film printed only on the motif, over matte board. Head-on it all but disappears; it shows as the sheet light's soft box mirrored in a surface flatter than the paper, a crisp sheen boundary at the film edge, and a faint wet darkening of the stock beneath. Drag the light and the reflection slides across the mark.

entry.call: fx.run(o, W, H, dpr, { S, clips })

in.o: params object — keys below; every length in CSS px
in.dpr: device px per CSS px (density is physical: marks per CSS px²)

x.S: params of every effect keyed by id; the stock this prints on is read from S[printsOn]
x.clips: Float32Array alpha per name (die), from FXSET.clips('fx-09-spot-uv', W, H, dpr, o) on a thread with fonts
x.umask: optional: clips.umask — a typed or image mask (mShape type | image)

out.lin: Float32Array W·H·3, linear-light sRGB, lit (encode with FX.toRGBA(R,"image",W,H))
out.ink: Float32Array W·H, this effect's own separation (plate), 0..1 (FX.toRGBA(R,"ink",…) = film positive)
out.stock: Float32Array W·H, height in CSS px (FX.toRGBA(R,"stock",…) = normalized height map)
out.marks: int: count of marks (pixel counts are per CSS px²)

light.note: az = direction the light comes FROM (screen degrees; 0 = right, 90 = below); el = elevation above the sheet

deterministic: yes: every random draw derives from the seed (position hashes or a seeded sequence); same inputs → same pixels in the same engine

params.label: Motif
params.note: the artwork: an invented mark (compass, sun, crescent, knot, a monogram from the text), a word, or a ring seal

params.label: Text
params.note: set in Archivo 800 for word, seal and monogram (its first letter)

params.label: Size
params.note: motif height as a share of the plate

params.label: Coverage
params.note: a solid film, or a fine line / dot screen of varnish

params.label: Varnish on
params.note: die = the motif is varnished · reverse = the sheet is varnished and the motif stays matte · die + field = a solid motif inside a patterned field

params.label: Pattern pitch
params.note: distance between lines or dots

params.label: Line / dot share
params.note: line width or dot diameter ÷ pitch

params.label: Pattern angle
params.note: angle of the line or dot screen

params.label: Keep-out
params.note: matte ring between the motif and the varnished field

params.label: Film build
params.note: film height in CSS px at the plate's macro scale (flat UV ≈ .1–.3, raised / tactile UV ≈ 1–2)

params.label: Edge rounding
params.note: width of the film's rounded shoulder, the meniscus that catches the light at the edge

params.label: Leveling
params.note: how far the film fills the tooth: 1 = a glass-flat top, 0 = the film follows the paper

params.label: Gloss
params.note: surface smoothness: a sharp-edged soft-box reflection and a tight glint at 1, satin at .3

params.label: Reflection
params.note: brightness of the soft box (the sheet light) seen in the film

params.label: Soft-box size
params.note: half-height of the sheet light's soft box as seen from the sheet (tangent units); its reflection is a window of sheen

params.label: Camera distance
params.note: viewer height in plate widths: closer = the reflection sweeps further across the sheet

params.label: Wet tone
params.note: darkening and deepening of the stock under the film (the varnish replaces the air in the tooth)

params.label: Stock darkness · L
params.note: OKLCH lightness of the board (FX-03 relief and fibers, this color)

params.label: Board · C

limits.why: most hues leave sRGB above ~.26 and get chroma-reduced

params.note: OKLCH chroma; reduced at constant L/h if it leaves sRGB

params.label: Board · h
params.note: OKLCH hue angle

params.label: Prints on
params.note: paper = FX-03 live (its tooth is what the film levels); smooth = a coated, toothless board

params.label: Seed
params.note: every random draw in the effect derives from this one number

recipe: Motif = an invented mark, a word or a ring seal (AA clip, main thread) → exact signed distance. Coverage pattern: solid, or an analytic line / dot screen intersected with the motif (or with the sheet around it), so every line and dot keeps a 1-device-px edge.

Film profile from the signed distance: a rounded shoulder (1 − (1 − d / rounding)²) rising to the film build. The film levels the FX-03 tooth: its top = lerp(tooth, smoothed tooth, leveling × profile) + build × profile.
Stock: FX-03's relief and fibers under a board color (OKLCH; dark by default). Matte = Lambert from FX-03 × albedo + a weak, broad rough-dielectric sheen on the tooth facets.

Film: Fresnel (n = 1.5, F₀ = .04) from a perspective viewer above the plate; the mirror vector samples the studio (a rectangular soft box at the sheet light, a dim ceiling, a dark room); gloss sets the box edge softness and the glint exponent. Under the film the matte sheen is gone and the stock is darker and deeper in OKLab (wet tone).
One light: the box center, glint and FX-03 shading all follow FX.LIGHT.

limits.what: a blister or a sticker, not a print finish
the sheen boundary aliases on 1× screens
lines and dots fall to a pixel checker at 1× (fine at 2×+)
reads as a matte or satin varnish: the mark stops revealing itself in the reflection
the soft box moves behind the viewer: the film nearly vanishes (as real spot UV does under overhead light)

clips.die: AA disc, center (W/2, H/2), radius .32·H device px

thumb.values: mean 8-bit sRGB per block, row-major, r g b
thumb.why: sha256 is exact in one engine. Engines may approximate Math.exp, Math.pow and Math.cbrt differently (they are not required to be correctly rounded), so pixels can differ by a level across engines; block means within 1/255 still prove the same render.
